messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: sarah.lin@atlascloud.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Monthly Platform Pulse: compact dashboard, OKR sync & QBR dry-run

Hi team + Sarah,

Attached is a compact runbook-style dashboard for November with the key signals we need to cover in the leadership QBR dry-run:

- Latency: p90 increased ~8% MoM (notable spike in EU SAT window, see chart pg2)
- Cost: unit cost / 1M tokens +12% MoM — largely due to automated fallback to the XLarge variant on 3 high-traffic routes
- Uptime: 99.92% this month; one 22-minute incident on 11/12 (brief router failure) — incident log attached
- Usage: active routes +18% MoM; peak concurrency up 24% in /v1/chat endpoints

Quick asks so we can fold this into QBR slides (deadline: COB Wed 11/18):
1) Vivek — can you confirm root cause for the p90 regression and whether the fallback routing is necessary for those routes? If it's autoscaler or kernel selection, propose an immediate mitigation.
2) Irene — please add updated OKR targets (latency/cost) and a short canary plan for the quantization rollout; include customer impact notes for AtlasCloud.
3) Tessa — can you schedule a 30-min dry-run (leadership + product) next week and own slide consolidation?

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cDashboardLink
Attachments: [202611-monthly-dashboard.pdf (PDF, 2.3MB)], [uptime-incident-log.csv (CSV, 45KB)]

Context for Sarah: we're pulling a short customer-impact summary for AtlasCloud to include on the QBR platform health slide — no action needed from you now, just FYI.

Thanks,
Chloe
Chloe Martin
Head of Platform Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, irene_choi@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 12:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Monthly Platform Pulse: compact dashboard, OKR sync & QBR dry-run

Chloe — quick summary after an initial triage:

- Root cause: autoscaler mis-tuning on a subset of EU hosts caused higher request queueing during the SAT batch window; that, combined with our smart-routing fallback policy, caused ~3% of traffic to route to the XLarge variant instead of the quantized L variant. The XLarge increases tail latency and cost.
- Short mitigation (this week): 1) pin top-10 routes to quantized-L variant (config change), 2) extend prefix-cache TTL by 30s for the affected routes, 3) temporary tighter autoscaler thresholds for EU SAT window.
- Medium term: ship the quantization canary (non-prod -> canary prod) on Nov 24, plus the kernel selection fix I'm tracking (PR in review).

Action items I'm assigning:
- Vivek: push config pins + cache TTL today; monitor p90.
- Infra SRE: tighten autoscaler thresholds for EU SAT window (I'll follow up with names).
- Chloe / Irene: include customer impact blurb for AtlasCloud if the canary timeline shifts.

I'll attach the quick root-cause note to the Drive folder (small doc).

— Vivek
VP, Serving Runtime

Deadline reminder: slide drafts by COB Wed 11/18 so we can run the dry-run on Fri 11/20. Chloe / Tessa — please confirm availability windows.
